Located in the heart of Windsor, Upton House School offers an excellent start to your child’s Upton journey (based on our most recent ISI inspection).
Our Open Mornings, in-person or virtual, give every parent the opportunity to see the school in action and everything we have to offer your child here at Upton House. You will have the opportunity to see what it's like for the children in their classrooms throughout the school, meet our warm and friendly staff and get a taster for what your child's Upton Journey could look like.
Our Stay and Play sessions offer nursery aged children the opportunity to come and play in the Little Upton Nursery. We warmly invite you and your child to experience our nurturing environment, where young minds thrive and curiosity is encouraged every day.

pageCache.pageTitle: Why Upton House? | Upton House School
pageCache.text:
Upton House School is excellent in all areas (ISI Report 2025) and offers a rich and fulfilling education, nurturing children and providing them with the very best start.
Our pupils are kind, confident and well-mannered, many having begun their time at Upton from two-years-old in our Little Upton Nursery. Boys and girls are prepared for entry to a wide range of highly reputable senior schools (age 11), many earning scholarships.
Pupils learn in a safe and friendly environment with outstanding facilities that help fulfil a child’s potential, whether that be in the arts, sport or academically.
Although Upton is non-selective at entry, we are an academic school and have high expectations for each child. From as early as nursery, we engage our children in new languages starting with French. Latin is introduced later in Year 5. We offer a wide range of extra-curricular activities for all abilities including art, chess, coding and many sports such as rugby, fencing, cricket, ballet, hockey, rugby, netball and judo.
Life skills, creativity and critical thinking are a priority. Drama, art, design and technology and music technology are key parts of our curriculum to help bolster confidence, vision and all our children sit the LAMDA (The London Academy of Music and Dramatic Arts) exams from Form 1 where Upton holds a 100% pass rate.
Pupils learn in an engaging, safe and friendly environment with outstanding facilities that help fulfil a child’s potential, whether that be in the sport, arts, music or academically. We use the York Club grounds in the Windsor Great Park for games afternoons and training and the children love to go there. Located in the heart of Windsor, very close to Windsor Castle, we are ideally placed for our children to explore the Long Walk, attend royal ceremonies, and truly embrace the historic town centre.
Upton House staff are enterprising, resourceful and loving making this school a very special place to learn, grow and be part of.
Parents are enormously important to us, we work closely with them to ensure they are part of this very important journey. Come and see for yourself.

pageCache.pageTitle: Upton House Friends | Upton House School
pageCache.text:
Here at Upton House we have a vibrant and active PTA - called Upton House Friends - who get together regularly to organise memorable events which fund extra wish list items for the School in order to enhance the children’s experiences.
Feel free to contact us anytime with comments and/or suggestions via [email protected].
UHF aims to raise money to provide luxury items that are not within the School's budget whilst enhancing the community spirit within our School. The UHF Committee work with the School to find out what might be on their wish list for the year. Once we have a list we decide how to spend UHF funds based on priority for the School and the UHF budget. Over the past few years the previous PTA has been able to raise funds for the amazing science lab, the sound and video system in Wallace Hall, the minibus that takes the children to activities, and the all-weather playing field.
